notes.title: Svae File Fix
notes.notes: This update addresses a critical issue where old save files could cause the game to crash or become unplayable. Now, if such an error is detected, all settings will automatically reset to default, allowing the game to continue without issues.

notes.title: Folder and music fix
notes.notes: Added new music tracks and fixed folder display issue.

notes.title: Unity 2023 Upgrade
notes.notes: We're thrilled to announce that we've just upgraded our game to Unity 2023, bringing a significant leap in physics and overall stability to enhance your gaming experience. You can expect smoother interactions, more realistic physics simulations, and an overall more stable gaming environment. Thank you for your continued support, and we can't wait for you to dive into the improved world of our game!

notes.title: Bugs and texture fix.
notes.notes:
Bug Fixes:

Addressed multiple minor bugs across various aspects of the game, improving overall stability.

Level Bug Fixes:

Level 7: Identified and fixed the underlying issue that sometimes caused a softlock in levels 7, 12, and 14, ensuring players can complete the level without issues.

Texture Updates:

Updated various textures throughout the game to align with the desired aesthetic and enhance overall visual appeal.

notes.title: Release version
notes.notes: Release version contains all 20 leves plus 20 challenges.
